To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the CryIA(c) 73 gene was successfully cloned and expressed in the minicells of E. coli, the gene was truncated and fused in frame with the GUS gene, a chimaeric construct was prepared and used as the passenger in a plant vector for plant transformation, and transgenic plants were obtained.
the cryIA(c) 73 gene was cloned, its expression was demonstrated in minicell system of E. coli, and the chimaeric gene of cryIA(c)-GUS was made, which was used as a passenger gene of a plant vector.
the gene for Bt toxin was cloned and expressed in E.coli and also in transgenic plants.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of a Bt gene from the HD73 strain of B. thuringiensis.
the development of a gene construct for expression of the entomocidal gene in plants and its use in the transformation of plants to confer resistance to the major lepidopterous insect pests.
the development of a gene construct which is capable of expressing the Bt toxin gene in transgenic plants.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we have cloned the cryIA(c) 73 gene, expressed it in E. coli, made a chimaeric construct and used it for plant transformation.
the cryIA(c) 73 gene is expressed in the transformed plant and the chimaeric gene is functional in the transformed plant.
a chimaeric Bt gene construct has been successfully introduced in the plant cells of tobacco and mustard and the gene is expressed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a chimaeric construct has been made for the expression of cryIA(c)-73 gene in plants.
the gene has been successfully cloned, tailored and expressed in E.coli minicell system and also in plant system.
we were successful in isolating the gene, cloning it in a suitable vector and making it available for expression in plants.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cryIA(c) 73 gene is a potent entomocidal gene and it could be used for the development of transgenic crops of India.
it is possible to clone the gene and express the protein in transgenic plants of tobacco and mustard.
the cryIA(c)173 gene is a good candidate for use in transgenic crop plants for the expression of insecticidally active protein in plant.
